info.title: EDINET API
info.description: AIsa gateway endpoints for EDINET document list and document download.

get.description: Lists every disclosure filed with Japan's EDINET on one date. date is required (YYYY-MM-DD). type=2 returns the filings under results — docID, filerName, secCode, JCN, docTypeCode, docDescription, submitDateTime, periodStart and periodEnd per filing — while type=1 returns metadata only, with the day's count under metadata.resultset.count and no results array. Measured at 612 KB for a typical business day (648 filings), and there are no filter parameters, so type=2 always returns the whole day; check the count with type=1 first when in doubt. About two thirds of filings carry a secCode (listed companies), the rest are funds and unlisted filers. A filing's docID feeds get_edinet_document_download.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Response mode: 1 for metadata only, 2 for metadata plus filing list.

200.description: EDINET document-list response. When `X-AISA-Cost-Mode` is `quote`, HTTP 200 returns a `cost_estimate` instead of executing this operation. The quote is not a reservation, authorization, or price lock.

metadata.description: Metadata object with title, request parameter echo, result count, processDateTime, status, and message.

401.description: Invalid or missing AIsa API key.

get.description: Downloads one filing by docID, taken from get_edinet_documents. The success response is a binary file, not JSON: type=1 returns the filing body and audit report as a ZIP archive (measured 11.9 KB, content-type application/octet-stream), type=2 the PDF (measured 15.0 KB, application/pdf). Errors still come back as JSON, so check the response content type before parsing. Because a tool result cannot usefully carry a binary payload, this endpoint stays REST-only: over MCP, stop at the docID from get_edinet_documents and fetch the file over REST.

parameters.name: docID
parameters.description: Document management identifier from the document list API.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: File type to download: 1 for filing body and audit report ZIP, 2 for PDF, 3 for alternate document and attachments ZIP, 4 for English document ZIP, 5 for CSV ZIP converted from XBRL.

200.description: Binary ZIP/PDF file content or JSON error payload depending on Content-Type. When `X-AISA-Cost-Mode` is `quote`, HTTP 200 returns a `cost_estimate` instead of executing this operation. The quote is not a reservation, authorization, or price lock.

401.description: Invalid or missing AIsa API key.

CostEstimate.description: Read-only cost quote for the exact request. No Provider call, billing reservation, durable job, or price lock is created.

currency.description: Quote currency. Always USD in this version.

estimate_kind.description: `exact` is a fully determined customer price; `upper_bound` has a locally enforceable ceiling in `max_cost_micros_usd`; `estimate` depends on terminal usage and may exceed the quoted amount.

estimated_cost_micros_usd.description: Quoted customer cost in micro-USD (1 USD = 1,000,000 micros).

max_cost_micros_usd.description: Optional hard customer-cost ceiling in micro-USD. Present for `exact` and `upper_bound`; omitted for `estimate`.

pricing_version.description: Optional immutable or compiled pricing version.

estimated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the quote was produced.

metadata.description: Bounded non-sensitive quote metadata, such as a canonical model or profile key.

XAISACostMode.name: X-AISA-Cost-Mode
XAISACostMode.description: Set to `quote` to estimate this exact request without executing data, creating a job, or authorizing spend. A successful quote is HTTP 200 with a `cost_estimate` body; it is not a reservation or price lock. Omit the header for normal execution. Any other value returns `400 invalid_cost_mode`. Quote mode requires an API key and cannot use MPP or x402.

CostEstimate.description: Read-only cost quote. The intended request is validated but not executed, billed, reserved, or locked.

Cache-Control.description: Quotes are never stored by shared caches.

Vary.description: Response body depends on the cost-mode header.
